name: 突发性检测
description: 分析 the 突发性 模式文本中的 to distinguish AI生成的 from 人类撰写的 content.
useCase: Detecting AI text through 分析 of 句子长度 and complexity variation
mechanism: 测量 the variation (突发性) in sentence structures, lengths, and complexity throughout a text. Human writing naturally varies 之间 simple and complex sentences, short and long paragraphs. AI生成的 text tends to maintain a more uniform level of complexity, resulting in lower 突发性 scores.
source: Guo et al. (2023) - How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection, arXiv
algorithm: Sentence Length Variance + Structural Complexity Scoring + Moving Window Analysis
parameters: 窗口大小: 5 sentences, Metrics: length 方差, complexity index, transition 熵
strengths:
• 简单且可解释的指标
• 在一定程度上与语言无关
• 与其他文本方法结合效果良好
• 对任意长度文本快速计算
limitations:
• Lower 准确度 as standalone detector
• Academic and technical writing naturally has low 突发性
• AI models are improving at mimicking human variability
• Very short texts are unreliable

references.title: Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? arXiv.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
Tulchinskii, E. et al. (2024). Intrinsic Dimension Estimation for Robust Detection of AI-Generated Texts. NeurIPS.
